# Watermark

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Configuration for rendering a text watermark over page content. The watermark is rendered at the specified opacity and rotation using PDF ExtGState for transparency and the cm operator for rotation.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`Color`](#color): Color of the watermark text (default: Gray500).
- [`FontName`](#fontname): Font family name for the watermark text (default: "Helvetica").
- [`FontSize`](#fontsize): Font size in points for the watermark text (default: 72).
- [`Opacity`](#opacity): Opacity of the watermark from 0.0 (invisible) to 1.0 (fully opaque).
- [`RotationDegrees`](#rotationdegrees): Rotation angle in degrees.
- [`Text`](#text): The watermark text to display (e.g. "DRAFT", "CONFIDENTIAL").

### `Opacity`

```csharp
float Opacity { get; set; }
```

Opacity of the watermark from 0.0 (invisible) to 1.0 (fully opaque). Default: 0.15.

### `RotationDegrees`

```csharp
float RotationDegrees { get; set; }
```

Rotation angle in degrees. Negative values rotate counter-clockwise. Default: -45 (diagonal from bottom-left to top-right).

### `Text`

```csharp
string Text { get; set; }
```

The watermark text to display (e.g. "DRAFT", "CONFIDENTIAL").
